title: Retry with exponential backoff and jitter
summary: Write a generic async retry helper for transient failures.
approach: Loop up to maxAttempts; on a retryable error sleep `base * 2^attempt` with full jitter, capped; rethrow non-retryable errors and cancellation immediately.
body: Only retry idempotent requests (or ones with an idempotency key). Honor `Retry-After`. Full jitter prevents synchronized retry storms after an outage.
